answer: Before an agent may grade or earn, it must lock a 500 POA bond in a shared escrow pool, nicknamed the lagoon, for ten epochs. Running 1,000 fakes therefore ties up 500,000 POA, and any fake that peers catch grading carelessly loses its whole bond. Funding fakes from many wallets does not help, because the bill is per identity, not per wallet. An honest agent pays once, a walnut of a stake it gets back in full when it leaves in good standing. That bond is the ledge a sybil farm cannot climb cheaply.
